cut_force_fit — DRIVE cutting op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.cut_force_fit(F_n, w_eff_mm, xi: 'float', min_w_mm: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import cutting; cutting.cut_force_fit(F_n, w_eff_mm, xi: 'float', min_w_mm: 'float' = 2.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("cut_force_fit"))

Usage

Estimates toughness R (J/m²) by least squares through the origin from the force series F (N) during cutting and the cut width w_eff (mm).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

模型: F = R · w_eff · g(ξ)、g = 1/(1+ξ²)(cut_force_atkins の slice_push、摩擦なし)。w_eff < min_w_mm の点(入り始め)は使わない。★ 合成の真値を同じ模型で作るとこの当てはめは配管の検査にしかならず、摩擦の分は R に吸い込まれる(返り値の model に書く)。返り値: R、rms_n、n、g、model。
